title: Critical dimension and size errors
statement: For each natural number $w$, let $s$ be the greatest natural number at most $2^{w+2}$ satisfying $1-(1-2^{-w})^s\le 1/2$, and define the critical dimension to be $ws$. Define the size error to be $(\log 2)2^w-s$ and the dimension error to be $(\log 2)w2^w-ws$. Then the dimension error equals $w$ times the size error.
hypotheses_covered: The critical size is the greatest qualifying $s\le 2^{w+2}$
